methods.name: public static AndroidShimResponseCache create(File directory, long maxSize) throws IOException
public boolean isEquivalent(File directory, long maxSize)
public CacheResponse get(URI uri, String requestMethod, Map<String, List<String>> requestHeaders) throws IOException
public CacheRequest put(URI uri, URLConnection urlConnection) throws IOException
public long size() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns the number of bytes currently being used to store the values in
   * this cache. This may be greater than the {@link #maxSize} if a background
   * deletion is pending.

methods.name: public long maxSize()
methods.comment:
* Returns the maximum number of bytes that this cache should use to store
   * its data.

methods.name: public void flush() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Force buffered operations to the filesystem. This ensures that responses
   * written to the cache will be available the next time the cache is opened,
   * even if this process is killed.

methods.name: public int getNetworkCount()
methods.comment:
* Returns the number of HTTP requests that required the network to either
   * supply a response or validate a locally cached response.

methods.name: public int getHitCount()
methods.comment:
* Returns the number of HTTP requests whose response was provided by the
   * cache. This may include conditional {@code GET} requests that were
   * validated over the network.

methods.name: public int getRequestCount()
methods.comment:
* Returns the total number of HTTP requests that were made. This includes
   * both client requests and requests that were made on the client's behalf
   * to handle a redirects and retries.

methods.name: public void close() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Uninstalls the cache and releases any active resources. Stored contents
   * will remain on the filesystem.

methods.name: public void delete() throws IOException
methods.comment: * Uninstalls the cache and deletes all of its stored contents.
